# Province of British Columbia Official Government Portal

> Central hub for BC government services covering health, education, employment, housing, justice, transportation, and social supports for residents and businesses.

www2.gov.bc.ca is the official government portal for the Province of British Columbia, providing access to all major provincial services and programs. The site serves residents, businesses, and visitors with information on healthcare, education, employment, social services, and administrative functions.

## Key Topics

- Province of British Columbia
- Government Services
- Health Services
- Education
- Employment and Business
- Life Events
- Housing and Tenancy
- Transportation
- Environmental Protection
- Justice and Legal Services
- Public Safety
- Taxes and Tax Credits
- Family and Social Supports
- First Nations and Indigenous Peoples
- Natural Resources

## Core Government Access

- [Home - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/home): Official BC government homepage with access to all major services
- [Home - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content): BC government portal providing access to public services
- [Find B.C. government services - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/home/services-a-z): A-Z directory of BC government programs and services

## Health and Medical Services

- [Health - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/health): BC healthcare, PharmaCare and medical coverage services

## Education, Employment and Economic Development

- [Education and training - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/education-training): Education and training services from K-12 to post-secondary
- [Employment, business and economic development - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/employment-business): Employment, business and economic development theme page

## Housing, Family and Social Services

- [Housing and tenancy - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/housing-tenancy): Housing, tenancy, affordable housing and BC Housing services
- [Family and social supports - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/family-social-supports): Family support, childcare, seniors, disability and income assistance
- [Birth, adoption, death, marriage and divorce - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/life-events): Vital records and life events services via Vital Statistics Agency

## Transportation, Safety and Justice

- [Driving and transportation - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/transportation): Driving, licensing, vehicle safety and DriveBC traveller info
- [Public safety and emergency services - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/safety): Public safety, emergency services and disaster preparedness
- [Law, crime and justice - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/justice): Legal system, court services and justice assistance programs

## Environment, Natural Resources and Industry

- [Environmental protection and sustainability - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/environment): Environmental protection, sustainability and natural resource mgmt
- [Farming, natural resources and industry - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/industry): Agriculture, forestry, mining, energy and industry services

## Taxes, Tourism, Culture and Governance

- [Taxes and tax credits - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/taxes): Provincial taxes, tax credits and eTaxBC services
- [Tourism and immigration - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/tourism-immigration): Tourism, immigration, settlement services and WelcomeBC
- [Sports, recreation, arts and culture - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/sports-culture): Sports, recreation, arts, culture and community grants
- [British Columbians and our governments - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/governments): BC government structure and governance information

## Optional

- [Data and information management - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/data): BC government data, geographic data and information management
- [Careers & MyHR - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/careers-myhr): BC Public Service careers and HR information for employees
